description: The two historic Unix sums, matching GNU sum. bsd rotates the 16-bit sum right and counts 1024-byte blocks. sysv reduces modulo 65535, keeps 65535 when the total is a positive multiple of it, and counts 512-byte blocks. "123456789" is bsd 53615 and sysv 477. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/byte-sum
